protocol.timing: one perf_counter call; includes tree arrays, boundary and numerical-range checks; excludes CSV loading, calibration, path comparison and output files
protocol.memory: separate fresh tracemalloc call; includes new arrays, boundary and output; excludes pre-existing inputs and first-call output; not process RSS
protocol.boundary: highest positive-payoff tree node; strict exercise >= continuation except indifference tolerance at R=1; no early exercise at R<1
protocol.tolerance: payoff noise cutoff=32 * float epsilon * strike, no absolute floor; tie tolerance only at R=1; price always max(exercise, continuation)
protocol.node_prices: reconstructed from log prices each row; when down == 1/up, enforce exact reciprocal log moves and exact central ATM nodes
protocol.expiry: highest positive-payoff tree node, using the same tolerance; no interpolation to strike
protocol.path_comparison: first observed P[t] <= boundary[t], including expiry; calibration uses the full window in hindsight; payoff excludes initial premium
protocol.samples: one timing call and one separate memory call; no medians or confidence intervals
